name: Cartesian
avoid_for: Decks that need visual heat, multiple accents, or a sense of urgency — the warm-neutral palette is intentionally low-energy
weak_cases: Dashboard density and many chart categories fight the sparse monograph hierarchy.
visual_signature: Stone and ink, true circles, sharp rectangles and restrained drafting geometry.

provenance.adaptation: Recipe retained and curated for Deck Studio; selector describes source-supported structures, not rendered acceptance.

language_posture: Preserve serif/sans roles where possible; inspect wider glyphs and long labels against circular geometry.

assets.images: No image required; type, shapes and surface treatments can carry the system.
